blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Пусть она ___ (обжечь / обжечься) на первом уроке, как людей сватать!»
exercises.why: «We already know that the verbs in "-ся" may be divided into several groups … Reflexive verbs. These verbs express an action which is directed back upon the agent or subject … Reciprocal verbs. The suffix "-ся" with these verbs indicates action of two or more actors upon one another … Verbs which never occur without the ending "-ся".» — DLI, Lesson 67. From Николай Лесков, «Жемчужное ожерелье».
exercises.context: «We already know that the verbs in "-ся" may be divided into several groups … Reflexive verbs. These verbs express an action which is directed back upon the agent or subject … Reciprocal verbs.…

exercises.q: Раздай им ___ (сам) — скажи, что ты даришь…»
exercises.why: Notice that the feminine adjectives have the same ending **-ой** (**-ей**) for all cases except for the nominative and accusative. — DLI, Lessons 46 and 47.  ·  From Николай Лесков, «Жемчужное ожерелье».
exercises.context: Notice that the feminine adjectives have the same ending **-ой** (**-ей**) for all cases except for the nominative and accusative.

exercises.q: В ___ (первое) издании книги М.
exercises.why: «The prepositional case is always used with a preposition. With the prepositions в and на it denotes a location … With the preposition о, об this case answers the questions о ком? о чём?» — DLI, Lesson 16. From Николай Лесков, «Жемчужное ожерелье».
exercises.context: «The prepositional case is always used with a preposition. With the prepositions в and на it denotes a location … With the preposition о, об this case answers the questions о ком? о чём?» — DLI, Lesson 16.

exercises.q: Притом и он ей очень ___ (понравиться / нравиться).
exercises.why: The verb **написать** is called perfective and expresses a single action with emphasis on its completion (either in the past or in the future, since the present tense deals only with actions in progress). — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 37.  ·  From Николай Лесков, «Жемчужное ожерелье».
exercises.context: The verb **написать** is called perfective and expresses a single action with emphasis on its completion (either in the past or in the future, since the present tense deals only with actions in progress).

exercises.q: Ну вот то-то и ___ (есть / съесть)!
exercises.why: The imperfective aspect emphasizes the action itself. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 37.  ·  From Николай Лесков, «Жемчужное ожерелье».
exercises.context: The imperfective aspect emphasizes the action itself.

exercises.q: «Встань, ___ (встать / вставать)! — говорит.
exercises.why: «The imperative may be formed from both the imperfective and the perfective verbs.» — DLI, Lesson 42. From Николай Лесков, «Жемчужное ожерелье».
exercises.context: «The imperative may be formed from both the imperfective and the perfective verbs.» — DLI, Lesson 42.

exercises.q: Ты ___ (неправый): старик поступил очень честно.
exercises.why: «There is a limited number of adjectives that normally take the short form when used predicatively … The short form of an adjective can never be used as a modifier.» — DLI, Lesson 57. From Николай Лесков, «Жемчужное ожерелье».
exercises.context: «There is a limited number of adjectives that normally take the short form when used predicatively … The short form of an adjective can never be used as a modifier.» — DLI, Lesson 57.

exercises.q: Зачем же отрицать то, что ты сам всегда ___ (уважать)?
exercises.why: «The past tense is formed by dropping -ть from the infinitive and adding -л for the masculine, -ла for the feminine, -ло for the neuter, -ли for the plural … the past does not have special endings for each person, but shows the gender and the number.» — DLI, Lesson 36. From Николай Лесков, «Жемчужное ожерелье».
exercises.context: «The past tense is formed by dropping -ть from the infinitive and adding -л for the masculine, -ла for the feminine, -ло for the neuter, -ли for the plural … the past does not have special endings for each person, but shows the gender and the number.» — DLI,…

exercises.q: Да, — отвечал тот, — вот я и поведу речь об этом, как вы ___ (говорить), прекрасном человеке.
exercises.why: «The following verbs belong to the "Е" type of conjugation: думать, слушать, спрашивать … The verb лежать belongs to the "И" type of conjugation.» — DLI, Lesson 16. From Николай Лесков, «Жемчужное ожерелье».
exercises.context: «The following verbs belong to the "Е" type of conjugation: думать, слушать, спрашивать … The verb лежать belongs to the "И" type of conjugation.» — DLI, Lesson 16.

exercises.q: Есть такая пословица: «Кто думает три дни, тот ___ (выбрать) злыдни».
exercises.why: «The perfective future consists of one word only and resembles in form the present tense. It is formed from the perfective infinitive: напишу, сделаю, получу, выучу.» — DLI, Lesson 37. From Николай Лесков, «Жемчужное ожерелье».
exercises.context: «The perfective future consists of one word only and resembles in form the present tense. It is formed from the perfective infinitive: напишу, сделаю, получу, выучу.» — DLI, Lesson 37.

exercises.q: Теперь он его будет ___ (ласкать / приласкать), пока там жениховский рученец кончится, а потом — быть бычку на обрывочку».
